predecessor_evidence: reports/research/LEDGER.md E-005: the reversal rule lost 0.0795 R gross per leg, which is relative strength persisting; E-001..E-004 were single-symbol and confounded by drift

dataset.alignment_rule: one shared bar grid; misaligned panels are refused

execution_model.entry: MARKET at the next bar open after a rank-state transition
execution_model.exit: static bracket, stop 2% / target 4% of entry, stop-first intrabar, 48-bar time exit
execution_model.funding: actual venue settlements inside the holding window
execution_model.sizing: risk 100 USDT per leg; R = net PnL / 100

candidates.statement: Relative strength across the ten perpetuals persists after costs: the strongest trailing-24h symbols outperform the weakest by more than the round-trip cost and more than a random two-and-two selection at the same bars.
candidates.direction_rule: LONG the two strongest trailing-24h symbols, SHORT the two weakest
candidates.event_rule: trade only when a symbol newly enters an extreme rank
candidates.falsified_by: net expectancy <= 0, or not above the matched random selection, or concentration in fewer than 6 of 10 symbols
candidates.double_test_disclosure: This is the mirror of E-005 on the same window. It is not independent evidence: it is a new hypothesis motivated by E-005's gross measurement, and the sealed holdout is its first confirmatory test.

matched_random_selection.pool: at each treatment event bar, two random longs and two random shorts from the same ten symbols, identical bracket, costs, funding and time exit
matched_random_selection.p_value: one-sided Monte Carlo: (1 + draws at least as good) / (1 + draws)

unit_of_comparison: per-leg net R; cross-market clustering unit is the per-symbol mean net R
secondary_metrics: gross expectancy per leg (the effect before costs)

gates.multiple_testing: Holm over the hypotheses in this family (one primary)

decision_rule: DEV_CANDIDATE only when every gate passes; otherwise NO_EDGE. A DEV_CANDIDATE is frozen and then evaluated on the sealed holdout exactly once. PASS can never be awarded by this screen.

hypothesis_budget.trials_declared: E-005 reversal (1 primary + 4 variants) and E-006 momentum (1 primary + 4 variants, of which 2 overlap the E-005 grid)

cumulative_dev_budget.note: Development is exploratory. The holdout is the only confirmatory read, and it will be spent once.

known_limitations: legs are priced independently and overlap in time; the pooled mean is an expectancy estimate, not a portfolio equity curve
shared-account competition and margin are not modelled by this screen
the effect is measured under a static 2%/4% bracket that truncates winners; a momentum rule may require a different exit, which this registration does not test
